title: Three Weeks and One Short Basket
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：wallet　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wallet 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the trader ① openned the wallet that no partner in the market would have noted, and he said the openning was the whole of the week. The ② wallet, meaning the purse itself and not the basket, ran three weeks and stayed unnoted in the book; a wallet, he said, is the only thing in a market that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ wallet in that market had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ wallet at the far stall, meaning the sample they kept for the children to show and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A wallet, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the trader said the noting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the wallet was the whole of the matter, meaning the saving and not the purse. The ⑥ wallet, meaning the saving and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; wallet, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both a purse and a saving. He said the saving is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ wallet had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ wallet of the whole thing, the trader wrote in October, was one market and three weeks of noting; wallet, he said, is either the sample at the far stall or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ wallet I remember is the purse noted in the list, which closed in 1968 and is still noted as the quietest in the market. A ⑩ wallet, my mother said in 1970, is the only purse that improves by being noted; every wallet, she said, is a saving that has agreed to look like a purse. She said the saving was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 钱包（指集市里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 钱包（指那只钱包本身，与小小的货篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：open the wallet 打开这一只钱包
D. n. 钱包（指留给孩子们给人看的那一份）
E. n. 钱包之事（抽象总称，指一处集市的钱包之事）
F. n. 钱包（指货单里写到、被记下的那一只）
G. n. 钱包、积蓄（指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 积蓄（抽象总称，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: openned the wallet that no partner in the market would have noted
The wallet, meaning the purse itself and not the basket
the wallet at the far stall
the wallet was the whole of the matter
the wallet had become a line in a list
The wallet of the whole thing
A wallet, my mother said in 1970

answers.why: open the wallet 意为“打开这一只钱包”，1961 年那位货商把集市里没有一位伙计肯记下的一只钱包做了一遍。
wallet 意为“钱包”，指那只钱包本身而不是小小的货篮，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记下。
wallet 意为“钱包”，指集市里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一只小小的货篮。
wallet 意为“钱包”，指最远那个摊子的留给孩子们给人看的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
wallet 意为“钱包、积蓄”，指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这只积蓄就是那件事的全部。
wallet 意为“积蓄”，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只钱包，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
wallet 意为“钱包”，指货单里写到、被记下的那一只，到 1966 年这一只成了货单里的一行。
wallet 意为“钱包之事”，货商十月写道，整件事的钱包之事是一处集市和三个星期的记下。
wallet 意为“钱包”，我记得的是货单里记下过的那一只，1968 年批完了，至今仍被说成集市里最安静的一只。
wallet 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，钱包是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的钱包。
